## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 7 specifics

- **714 pages carry index entries**, 6,877 index headwords, 6,702 distinct. Located 93.1%, label +
  body 87.3%. No page is bound out of order, and the misfiled-headword test finds nothing.
- **Against the typed witness** (`docs/witness-join.md`): it has 6,689 of the 6,702 distinct
  headwords (99.8%). Labels agree on 98.9% of the 6,005 rows where both have one; analyses are
  ≥ 0.8 similar in 91.7%, < 0.4 in 0.6%.
- **A new confusion, ဒွ read as ဒ္ဒ**: the whole run ဆဒွါရ… on p. 759 (14 headwords) is read
  ဆဒ္ဒါရ…. Recall misses all of them; the fuzzy alignment places all 14 right (checked on the
  image). It cannot join `abhidhana_fold.py` as it stands, which folds one character for one.
- **A gutter cut in the wrong place**: on p. 527 the gutter was taken at 0.467 of the width,
  inside the accepted 0.44–0.555 but left of the real channel, and the right column came out as
  interleaved fragments. Its seven entries: two placed on garbled text, five unlocated. Nine
  pages of this volume have the whole-page pass reading at least three headwords more than the
  column pass (23 in vol. 6), which is where to look for more of these.
- **Readings left unnormalised** are few and mostly sense numbers read as labels, (၂), (၁), (၃),
  or the tail of a headword, (ပ္ပ), (မ္မ).

## Spot checks against the page images

Three pages, every article compared with `07.pdf` at 72 dpi (25 September 2026).

| page | chosen because | index headwords | at the right entry | wrong entry | unlocated | labels |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 400 | an ordinary page | 9 | 9 | 0 | 0 | 9 right |
| 759 | the worst page (3 of 14 read) | 14 | 14 | 0 | 0 | 14 right |
| 527 | the next worst (4 of 12) | 12 | 5 (+2 on garbled text) | 0 | 5 | 5 right, 2 not read |

- **P. 400**: nine entries of စိဏ္ဏ…, two placed by fuzzy match, all right.
- **P. 759**: the ဆဒွါရ… run (above), every entry fuzzy and every one right, with its label.
- **P. 527**: the left column's five entries are right. The right column is the gutter failure
  above: စိရနိဝါသီ and စိရနိသဇ္ဇာ are placed inside the fragments of their own entries; the other
  five are unlocated.

No article on the three pages is placed at a wrong entry, and no label is wrong.
